name: app-flow-cycling-icon-reveal-on-iphone-home-screen
title: Flow cycling app icon revealed on an iPhone lock screen with a Turkish tagline
whatItIs: A white slide with the bold headline 'Daha Akıllı Sür, Daha Uzağa Git.' (Ride Smarter, Go Further) above a cropped iPhone showing the mint 'Flow' app icon with a red notification badge among Maps, Health, Wallet and Settings on a lock screen.
whatItMeans: Confident and real; placing the icon among familiar system apps makes a concept feel like a shipped product.
techniques: Reveal an app icon in situ on a real lock screen.
Lead with a benefit-driven tagline before any UI.
Keep the palette to mint green and white.

vocabulary.definition: The small number or dot on an app icon showing new activity.
Showing a design in its real, expected context.
